title: 第19章 河水之争第20章 春风化雨
content_zh:
惠春县，苏家村。
日头偏西，余晖洒在村口的古槐树上，将那苍老的枝干映得如同一尊镀金的守望者。
树下青光微闪，空气中泛起一圈肉眼难辨的涟漪。
苏秦的身影显现出来。
他脚下微微踉跄了一步，随即稳住身形，轻吐一口浊气。
这内舍腰牌自带的“地脉传送”确实神妙，能顷刻间跨越数十里，但这消耗也着实不小。
也就是他如今突破到了聚元三层，气海充盈，若是换做之前，怕是一落地就得腿软。
“这就是回家的代价，不过倒也算是另类的修行。”
苏秦调息片刻，感受着周围那熟悉的、混合着泥土与庄稼气息的燥热空气，心神渐渐放松下来。
他掸了掸衣摆上并不存在的尘土，步履轻快地向着自家的青砖阔院走去。
推开那扇厚实的黑漆木门，院子里的景象映入眼帘。
父亲苏海正坐在那张有些年头的老藤椅上，手里拿着他最爱的那个紫砂壶。
只是平日里这壶不离嘴，今日却被他紧紧攥在手里，甚至壶嘴都歪向了一边，茶水滴滴答答落在裤腿上也浑然不觉。
他的目光有些发直地盯着院墙角的一株石榴树，眉头紧锁，透着一股说不出的焦虑与期盼。
“爹。”
苏秦轻唤了一声。
苏海猛地回过神，手里的茶壶一晃，这才感觉到裤腿上的湿热。
他慌忙放下茶壶，抬头看来。
当看清站在门口、一身青衫长身玉立的苏秦时，苏海先是一愣，随即猛地站起身来，动作急切得带翻了身边的矮凳。
“秦儿？！”

苏海快步走来，那双阅尽世事的老眼中闪过一丝慌乱，上下打量着儿子
“怎么这时候回来了？这才去了几天？是不是……是不是道院里有什么变故？”
在他看来，儿子正是修行的紧要关头，突然回家，多半不是什么好兆头。
看着父亲那患得患失的模样，苏秦心中一暖，连忙上前扶住父亲，温声道
“爹，您想哪去了。没变故，是好事。”
他从腰间解下那块温润的云纹腰牌，递到苏海面前，语气中带着一丝安抚与自豪
“您看。”
苏海接过腰牌，手指颤巍巍地抚过上面流转的灵光，还有那个铁画银钩的“内”字。
他是见过世面的富户，自然知道这东西的分量。
“这……这是内舍的牌子？”
苏海的声音有些发颤，抬头看向儿子，眼中满是难以置信的惊喜。
“是。”
苏秦笑着点头，给了父亲一颗定心丸
“爹，这三年没白熬。儿子已经突破了境界，被教习特批进了内舍。下个月的二级院考核，名也报上了。”
“好好好！好啊！”
苏海一连说了三个好字，眼眶瞬间就红了。
他紧紧攥着那块腰牌，像是攥着苏家几代人的希望。
“我就知道！我就知道我儿能行！”
content_en:
Huichun County, Sujia Village.
The sun is tilted to the west, and the afterglow shines on the ancient locust tree at the entrance of the village, reflecting the old branches like a gilded watchman.
The green light flashed slightly under the tree, and there was a ripple in the air that was difficult to discern with the naked eye.
Su Qin's figure appeared.
He staggered slightly, then steadied himself and took a breath.
The "earthline teleportation" that comes with this Nei She Yao card is indeed magical and can span dozens of miles in an instant, but the consumption is really not small.
That is to say, he has now broken through to the third level of Juyuan, and his Qi sea is full. If he had done it before, he might have weakened his legs as soon as he landed.
"This is the price of going home, but it can be regarded as a different kind of practice."
Su Qin adjusted his breath for a moment, feeling the familiar hot air around him that was mixed with the smell of soil and crops, and gradually relaxed his mind.
He brushed off the non-existent dust on his clothes and walked briskly towards his wide blue brick courtyard.
Pushing open the thick black-painted wooden door, the scene in the yard came into view.
Father Su Hai is sitting on the old wicker chair, holding his favorite purple clay pot in his hand.
But usually the pot never leaves his mouth, but today he held it tightly in his hand, even the spout was tilted to one side, and the tea dripped onto his trouser legs without even noticing.
He stared straight at a pomegranate tree in the corner of the courtyard, his brows furrowed, revealing an indescribable anxiety and expectation.
"Dad."
Su Qin called out softly.
Su Hai suddenly came back to his senses, shook the teapot in his hand, and then felt the heat and moisture on his trouser legs.
He hurriedly put down the teapot and looked up.
When he saw Su Qin standing at the door, wearing a long green shirt and standing tall, Su Hai was stunned for a moment, then stood up suddenly, his movements so eager that he knocked over the low stool beside him.
"Qin'er?!"
Su Hai walked over quickly, a trace of panic flashed in his old eyes that had seen everything in the world, and he looked at his son up and down.
"Why are you back now? How many days have you been here? Is... is there something going on in the Taoist temple?"
In his opinion, his son's sudden return home was probably not a good sign since it was a critical moment for his practice.
Seeing his father worrying about gains and losses, Su Qin felt warm in his heart. He quickly stepped forward to support his father and said warmly:
"Dad, where did you want to go? Nothing happened, which is a good thing."
He took off the warm cloud pattern waistband from his waist and handed it to Su Hai, with a hint of comfort and pride in his tone.
"Look."
Su Hai took the badge and tremblingly touched the aura flowing on it with his fingers, as well as the word "内" painted with iron and painted with silver hooks.
He is a wealthy man who has seen the world, so he naturally knows the weight of this thing.
"This...is this the brand of Neishe?"
Su Hai's voice was trembling, and he looked up at his son, his eyes full of unbelievable surprise.
"Yes."
Su Qin smiled and nodded, giving his father reassurance.
"Dad, these three years have not been in vain. My son has broken through the realm and has been specially approved by the instructor to enter the inner dormitory. His name has also been registered for the second-level college assessment next month."
"Okay, okay! Okay!"
Su Hai said three good words in a row, and his eyes instantly turned red.
He clutched the waist card tightly, as if clutching the hope of generations of the Su family.
"I knew it! I knew my son could do it!"
